content:
Rumors suggest Apple has been working on a major revamp of its Home lineup for years, and a new leak has provided a promising product list.

macOS code leak mentions multiple unreleased Home devices

Apple's most important annual event is just weeks away. Several new Home products are expected to be unveiled alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, as well as new Apple Watch models.

Rumors indicate a new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad are all set to launch, but several other Home products may also be on the horizon.

Yesterday, MacRumors discovered that the newly released macOS 26.7 RC contains clues related to several unreleased products.

Among them are codenames linked to Home devices. According to Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be the version of the home hub with a dock, while J491 is designed for wall-mounted installation."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): Since the HomePod mini's codename is B520, this is very likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Very likely the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Unknown Home device codenames appearing once again.
  • ATVRemote1,5: A new generation Siri Remote expected to launch alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products reportedly in development include a video doorbell and a desktop robot-style home hub. It is unclear at this stage whether their codenames also appear in the macOS 26.7 leak.

Besides products, MacRumors also discovered a codename called "Pebble," believed to be the development codename for homeOS. Additionally, there is a string "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning," which may be related to the HomePad.

Finally, four colors for an unspecified Home accessory were also found in the leak: rose pink, silver, space gray, and starlight.
